Own product · BARVIS FocusTechnical showcase

Focus that stays
connected to the goal.

I built this app for my own work. It shows how I handle the harder parts of the job: syncing across devices, speed and accessibility.

Problem
A timer in one app, tasks in another, notes in a third. No clear view of where the time went.
Solution
A Pomodoro timer tied to a project and task, analytics by day, week and month, and skill levels that grow with time invested.
Technical
The same timer runs on desktop and phone. Main screen cut from 6 MB to 110 KB. Everything works with the keyboard alone.
Stack
Django, PostgreSQL, Docker; private server.
  • Timer on every device
  • Keyboard shortcuts
  • Analytics and CSV export
  • WCAG accessibility
  • Private server
